CustomField.description: This field is a formula field that carries over into the opportunity. It mirrors the doc formulas fields that indicate Legal Status of the business. (Corp, LLC, Partnership, Sole) This will be a reference for the ops team to use when creating legal docs.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is a read only field. If this field is blank, please populate the Legal Status field on the Account record.
CustomField.label: Legal Status
